user.title: PRE Point
user.description: Sign in with your PRE Point (PRE CHARGE app) account.

tariff.title: Your tariff
tariff.description: PRE does not show prices, so they are calculated from your tariff. A session is priced when it first appears; you can change the prices later in the options.

locations.title: Chargers to watch
locations.description: Places where you charged are pre-selected; PRE chargers around your home are listed too. Change the radius or the filter and submit to search again; submit unchanged to finish.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Automatic sign-in for {username} was stopped. Enter the password again.

error.invalid_auth: PRE rejected the e-mail or password.
error.pre_login_failed: Signing in to PRE Point failed. See the Home Assistant log.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the PRE API.
error.map_unavailable: The public charger map is not available right now. You can finish without chargers and add them later.

init.title: PRE Point options
init.description: Change the radius or the filter and submit to search for more chargers; submit unchanged to save.

data.recalculate: Recalculate earlier sessions with these prices

data_description.recalculate: Otherwise the new prices only apply to new sessions.

error.map_unavailable: The public charger map is not available right now.
